title: Active ScreenConnect Attacks Target Managed Service Providers
excerpt: ConnectWise is investigating a malware campaign using compromised ScreenConnect environments to target MSPs and deploy rogue clients.
body_html:
ConnectWise is currently investigating an active malware campaign that targets managed service providers, commonly known as MSPs. The malicious activity involves the use of compromised ScreenConnect environments.

According to the reports, attackers are leveraging these breached environments to distribute and install rogue remote-access clients directly onto customer devices. The ongoing campaign has impacted dozens of organizations so far.

Investigations into the scope and method of the breaches are currently underway as the company looks to address the security issues surrounding the targeted environments.
